# Aims

- Background on problems and on Seedcase
- Describe data lifecycle (within GenomeDK)
- Focus on operational and procedural side
- Share future plans

# Problems with data in research

::: notes
How many have done data analysis at some point in their career? Or who have
talked with people who do data analysis and hear them complain/get frustrated?
:::

## Anyone ever... spent way too much time getting data ready for analysis? {.center}

## Anyone ever... had no idea what a particular column name meant? {.center}

## Anyone ever... had questions about data that only past researchers could answer? {.center}

## Data processing and cleaning takes far too long {.center}

## Data processing and cleaning is rarely documented {.center}

# Seedcase and ON-LiMiT

## From raw data to analysis-ready {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: onlimit-data-package

flowchart LR
  redcap[("REDCap")]
  myfood24[("MyFood24")]
  others[("...<br>other<br>sources")]

  package_source["Data package<br>development"]
  data_package[(Data package)]
  website[Website]

  subset1[("Data subset:<br> Research analysis 1")]
  subset2[("Data subset:<br> Research analysis 2")]

  redcap & others & myfood24 -->
    package_source -->
    data_package & website

  data_package --> subset1 & subset2
```

## Building the critical metadata {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: metadata-lifecycle

flowchart TB
  raw[("Raw (meta)data<br>source")]
  new_version[Create<br>new version]
  data_package[(Data package)]
  website[Rebuild<br>website]

  subgraph metadata ["Steps for metadata"]
    extract[Extracting] -->
      clean[Cleaning] <-->
      edit[Editing] & check[Checking]

    edit <--> check

    check -->
      build[Building]
  end

  raw -->
    metadata -->
    new_version --> data_package & website

  new_version -->|repeat| metadata

  style metadata fill:none
```

## Raw-to-ready data pipeline {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: data-lifecycle

flowchart TB
  raw[("Raw data<br>source")]
  new_version[Create<br>new version]
  data_package[(Data package)]

  subgraph data ["Steps for data"]
    split[Splitting] <-->
      join[Joining] <-->
      clean[Cleaning] <-->
      reshape[Reshaping]
    split <--> clean
    clean <-->
      check <-->
      reshape
    check[Checking] -->
      build[Building]
  end

  raw -->
    data -->
    new_version -->
    data_package

  new_version -->|repeat| data

  style data fill:none
```

## Build reproducible, versioned packages {.center}

feasibility-data_v1.0.0.zip/

# Relevant operational and procedural aspects

## Need strong coordination from end-to-end {.center}

To create analysis-ready data

## Some things make sense for data collection {.center}

... but not for later analysis (as we experienced in feasibility)

## Data package website as "first stop" {.center}

<https://onlimit-study.github.io/feasibility-data/>

## Data request flow {.center}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: request-flow

flowchart LR
  request_page["Data request<br>webpage"]
  recipe["Generated<br>request 'recipe'"]
  create_subset["Run create<br>subset command"]
  subset_data[("Requested data<br>subset")]

  request_page -->|Select columns<br>and rows| recipe
  recipe -->|Email<br>recipe| create_subset
  create_subset -->|Generate<br>subset| subset_data
```
